baseline_prompt_en: A quiet travel photograph centers a ceramic coffee cup on a railway station windowsill. A departing train passes beyond the glass in soft morning light. The pale glazed cup holds a shallow remainder of coffee, its rim and small handle clearly described against the worn stone sill. Slight motion softness carries along the train windows outside while the cup and the nearby window frame stay crisp. Faint reflections in the glass join the warm interior edge to the cooler platform beyond. The still cup occupies the foreground, and the train remains recognizable in the softer background. Restrained color and gentle shadows leave the image feeling like a paused moment during a journey.
